svg.desc: Jerome Zarate, full-stack engineer. Five years across Node.js, TypeScript and React. I build commission ledgers that reconcile, message sync that survives reconnects, AI pipelines with a human sign-off, and whole products from schema to deploy. Available for work, full-time or contract. Philippines, UTC+8.
